mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_project ( user_id, project_name, project_role, project_desc, personal_duty, achievement, tech_stack, start_date, end_date, project_link, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{projectName}, #{projectRole}, #{projectDesc}, #{personalDuty}, #{achievement}, #{techStack}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{projectLink}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_project SET project_name = #{projectName}, project_role = #{projectRole}, project_desc = #{projectDesc}, personal_duty = #{personalDuty}, achievement = #{achievement}, tech_stack = #{techStack}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, project_link = #{projectLink}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM growth_project WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
